source: Audited public PR46 indicator implementation; pececillos, not tendencia; red EMA remains EMA15(tendencia)
patterns_confirmed_by_owner: 2026-11-15; exact numerical conventions below are research conventions, not privately verified Bitman rules

P1_PEAK_EXHAUSTION.ao_event: two slopes in side direction after two opposite slopes; AO must stay on opposite side through four bars
P1_PEAK_EXHAUSTION.pececillos_event: same two-before/two-after slope turn; no red-line cross required
P1_PEAK_EXHAUSTION.adx_event: peak: two strict increases followed by two strict decreases

P2_TROUGH_ONSET.ao_event: two slopes in side direction after two opposite slopes
P2_TROUGH_ONSET.pececillos_event: same two-before/two-after slope turn; no red-line cross required
P2_TROUGH_ONSET.adx_event: trough: two strict decreases followed by two strict increases
P2_TROUGH_ONSET.direction_filter: minus_di > plus_di for SHORT; plus_di > minus_di for LONG; price break diagnostic only

P3_FAILED_RECOVERY.ao_sign: same side; below zero for SHORT; above zero for LONG
P3_FAILED_RECOVERY.ao_event: two slopes of correction followed by two slopes in hypothesized side; all five AO values remain on original zero side
P3_FAILED_RECOVERY.pececillos_event: same two-before/two-after slope turn; no red-line cross required
P3_FAILED_RECOVERY.adx_event: none; record ADX level and curvature without inventing an extra ADX gate
P3_FAILED_RECOVERY.context: unfiltered primary; closed4H/1D concordance secondary, never a replacement primary

mirrors: P1 SHORT, P2 LONG, P3 LONG are predeclared controls/hypotheses, not operational signals

confirmation.expiry: oldest token age >2 closes clears whole bundle
confirmation.invalidation: AO sign/alignment or pececillos slope loses required direction; ADX direction reverses for P1/P2; DMI alignment lost P2; invalid bar or gap resets
confirmation.cooldown: per pattern+side; starts at every valid ALL event before intensity filtering; suppressed tokens consumed

intensity.rank: strictly earlier window only; empirical midrank (#less+0.5*#equal)/n

metrics.adx_level: ADX at vertex t-2, percentile versus 720 bars strictly before vertex
metrics.adx_turn: abs(mean(last2 ADX deltas)-mean(previous2 ADX deltas)); rank versus strictly prior 720 such values
metrics.ao_intensity: abs(AO[t]-AO[t-2])/close[t]; rank against prior 720; abs(AO)/close and normalized per-bar slopes also logged

intensity.selection: minimum of applicable tail ranks: high ADX level for P1; 1-level rank for P2; ADX curvature for P1/P2; AO and pececillos turn ranks for every pattern. At a bundle confirmation use ranks frozen at each token event. ALL requires no percentile threshold. Never relax to fill a quota.

statistical_family.primary: six pattern/side contrasts Q75 net12h minus same-side matched controls
statistical_family.multiplicity: Holm across all six; untestable cells assigned p=1; one-sided centered calendar-block bootstrap, not randomization proof
statistical_family.power_sigma: development paired-excess standard deviation for same cell; if <2 matched use conservative sqrt(2)*max SD of all development LONG/SHORT12h returns
statistical_family.effective_n: min(n, sample variance / calendar7day block-bootstrap variance of mean paired differences); n<2 or <20 occupied calendar blocks NO TESTABLE
statistical_family.no_promotion: secondary evidence never changes primary classification

outcomes.entry: open of first H1 after available_at; adverse slippage0.0005; next-open idealized latency assumption, not guaranteed fill
outcomes.exit: open entry_i+horizon, adverse0.0005; no voluntary SL/TP in Phase1
outcomes.cost_basis: conservative inherited research assumption, not claimed Bitunix personal fee
outcomes.funding: actual Binance USD-M settlements strictly inside holding interval; boundary settlements create explicit conservative/optimistic inclusion bounds; missing exact marks use H1 mark high/low bounds, exact net null; never call Binance cashflows Bitunix observations

match: last closed4H close vs SMA200 regime
controls.sampling: fixed seeded without replacement per cell; no outcomes in selection
controls.no_fallback: retain unmatched event; no change of side/month/regime/volatility or minimum controls; inference uses matched subset and publishes coverage

data.observed_diagnostic: October-November2026 excluded from inferential evaluation; NO VIRGIN HOLDOUT anywhere in previously inspected history

forward.minimum_duration: full fixed12 months, no performance stopping
forward.sample_goal: each cell frozen required effective_n from development power artifact; no magic successful count
forward.finalization: one final inferential read after end+24h; insufficient sample/coverage remains NO TESTABLE, no silent extension
forward.capture: future separately reviewed observer; original emitted records+raw sources+hashes; no historical signals imported
forward.late_activation: missed intervals remain missing, dates unchanged; >=95% hour coverage and all primary events auditable required; otherwise NO TESTABLE

phase2.primary_size: fixed1% simulated equity maximum planned monetary risk including both fees, execution reserve and funding reserve; qty from causal structural stop; no leverage needed in primary
phase2.stress_only: 50% remaining balance initial isolated margin,10x; never primary; no automatic top-up
phase2.not_frozen: structural stop, TP1 fraction/level, netBE and trailing require a separate pre-outcome Phase2 spec; no management backtest now
phase2.liquidation: official current metadata cannot certify historical Bitunix rules; conditional calculations only, exact liquidation backtest blocked without verified marks/tiers/fees/funding and intrabar ordering
